rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something situated in, facing, or associated with the west.

example.english: We sat on the western balcony to watch the sunset.
example.traditional: 我哋坐喺西面嘅露台睇日落。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zo6 hai2 sai1 min6 ge3 lou6 toi4 tai2 jat6 lok6

rows.jyutping: jau4 sai1 min6 ceoi1 lei4 ge3 N
rows.note: Use this specifically when N is a wind blowing from the west, rather than merely something located to the west.

example.english: The western wind is pretty strong today.
example.traditional: 今日由西面吹嚟嘅風幾大。
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 jau4 sai1 min6 ceoi1 lei4 ge3 fung1 gei2 daai6
